title: Contrast (Minimum)
normative_text: Text and images of text have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, except for large-scale text and incidental or logotype text.

failures.title: Failure due to specifying foreground colors without specifying background colors or vice versa

sufficient.title: Sufficient technique for Images of Text

advisory.title: Advisory technique for Images of Text

title: Contrast (Enhanced)
normative_text: Text and images of text have a contrast ratio of at least 7:1, except for large-scale text and incidental or logotype text.

sufficient.title: Sufficient technique for Low or No Background Audio

advisory.title: Advisory technique for Low or No Background Audio

title: Visual Presentation
normative_text: For visual presentation of blocks of text, users can select foreground and background colors; width is no more than 80 characters; text is not justified; line spacing is at least space-and-a-half; and text can be resized without horizontal scrolling.

failures.title: Failure due to using text that is fully justified

sufficient.title: Sufficient technique for Images of Text (No Exception)

advisory.title: Advisory technique for Images of Text (No Exception)

title: Non-text Contrast
normative_text: The visual presentation of user interface components and graphical objects has a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against adjacent colors.

title: Text Spacing
normative_text: No loss of content or functionality occurs when line height, paragraph spacing, letter spacing, and word spacing are overridden to specified values.

title: Focus Appearance
normative_text: When a user interface component receives keyboard focus, the component is not entirely hidden due to author-created content.

title: Error Identification
normative_text: If an input error is automatically detected, the item in error is identified and the error is described to the user in text.

title: Labels or Instructions
normative_text: Labels or instructions are provided when content requires user input.

title: Error Suggestion
normative_text: If an input error is automatically detected and suggestions for correction are known, suggestions are provided unless they jeopardize security or purpose.

title: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
normative_text: For pages causing legal commitments, financial transactions, data modification or test submissions, submissions are reversible, checked, or confirmed.
